name: Camp Mojache
summary: Camp Mojache is the primary Horde outpost in Feralas, established as a fortified tauren settlement along the waters feeding Wildwind Lake. It provides shelter, provisions, and flight connections to travelers contending with the untamed wilderness, aggressive wildlife, and ancient ruins of the deep forest.

sections.title: A Tauren Bastion in the Rainforest
sections.body: Situated in eastern Feralas along a swift-flowing stream that feeds Wildwind Lake, Camp Mojache is a tauren settlement built to secure a foothold in the wild southern forest. While the dense jungle holds perilous threats—from savage wildlife to Gordunni ogres and aggressive Woodpaw gnolls—the camp stands as an island of safety. Equipped with lodging, trade masters, and a wind rider roost, it serves as the vital logistical hub for Horde champions operating in the region.

sections.title: Frontier Outpost
sections.body: The camp's hunters and braves are renowned for their courage and thick hides, maintaining constant vigilance against raids from the surrounding wilderness. For the Horde, holding Mojache is essential for projecting influence across Feralas, checking the presence of both the Night Elves from the coast and the dark forces lurking within Dire Maul.

faq.answer: Camp Mojache is the main Horde base of operations in Feralas. Built and maintained predominantly by the tauren, it straddles a stream emptying into Wildwind Lake and offers resting facilities, trade supplies, and flight transport.

faq.q: Who leads or defends the camp?
aliases: who is in charge of camp mojache
faq.answer: The settlement is protected by seasoned tauren braves who guard against incursions from local beast packs, Gordunni ogres, and aggressive Woodpaw gnolls that prowl the woods just to the west.

faq.q: Where does the local flight master travel?
aliases: where can i fly from camp mojache
faq.answer: From the camp's wind rider perch, travelers can reach central hubs such as Thunder Bluff, the Crossroads in the Barrens, Shadowprey Village in Desolace, and neighboring outposts like Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

faq.q: What major threats surround Camp Mojache?
faq.answer: The surrounding woods are home to the Woodpaw gnoll clan to the west, territorial Gordunni ogres to the north and south, and Alliance forces operating out of the distant western coast at Feathermoon Stronghold.

angles.text: Camp Mojache represents the farthest southern reach of your people's traditional craftsmanship and settlements in Kalimdor, carving out harmony within the deep rainforest.
As the Horde's sole fortified hub in Feralas, Mojache is your only refuge for resting, restocking provisions, and securing swift transport across the deep forest.
